transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this release-readiness huddle started. As we all know, the critical patch for the production authentication service has passed staging validation and is approved for a controlled production rollout during this week's maintenance cycle. I own the binding rollout decision and will be recording the final operating policy. Before I make that call, I need to hear from each of you — security operations, reliability, customer support, and compliance — on any operational requirements or concerns you have. Let's go around the room.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something urgent. This morning, while reviewing fresh threat-intelligence telemetry for an unrelated investigation, I confirmed active probing of the authentication endpoint that this patch addresses. Because of that, Security Operations requires two conditions before we proceed: first, the initial rollout must be limited to exactly 10 percent of production instances, and second, a WAF rule must be enabled before we expand the rollout any further. I have not yet attached the telemetry to the release record, but I will do so immediately after this huddle.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to raise a customer support concern. I confirmed with account operations this afternoon that exactly 3 enterprise customers in the EU region require a service notice before any authentication maintenance, and none of them has received that notice yet. I was holding off on opening the support task until we knew the final rollout shape, but this needs to be factored into our decision — those notices must go out before we proceed.
transcript.speaker: A4

During an audit-evidence review today, I confirmed that this patch rollout must retain its approval, exposure, and verification evidence for exactly 400 days. Additionally, the compliance ticket has not yet been linked to the release record — that linkage needs to happen as part of this rollout so our retention and audit trail obligations are met.

transcript.text: I need to raise a reliability requirement. During a capacity review unrelated to this patch, I measured that the authentication service's ARM instances need a restart drain period and must be restarted with exactly 2 instances in parallel or fewer to preserve quorum. I have not yet updated the rollout runbook with that result, but this constraint needs to be factored into the rollout plan — we cannot exceed 2 concurrent instance restarts without risking quorum loss.
